statement: 2014 NBS values use the revised 2025 vintage; agents do not receive 2015-2024 targets. This is not a real-time historical forecast.
NEA2015-vintage proportions split NBS2025-vintage 2014 thermal capacity; the split is reconstructed, never an observed revised split.

Unclassified thermal, other generation and the 11e8 kWh NEA discrepancy are unmodelled. Hydro includes pumped storage in the observed category; the reduced proxy cannot claim storage or reliability fidelity.

Primary fuel less reconstructed power input is a residual-account service. It includes transformation/nonenergy discrepancies and is NOT measured useful heat or transport activity. Sector owners are bookkeeping assignments.

GCB2014 coal/oil/gas emissions divided by NBS2014 fuel-equivalent energy provide fixed effective inventory coefficients. They are not chemical factors or a reviewed GCB/NBS equivalence. Cement, flaring, other and removals are excluded.
One fixed 2014 ratio maps named nonthermal generation to the NBS primary-electricity-and-other category. This proxy cannot identify nonfossil consumption or its changing statistical conversion.

Four 6-hour blocks repeat 365 times. Assumed demand shape 0.9/1/1.1/1, flat non-solar availability and daytime solar preserve reference annual means. No measured weather, ramp events or reliability probabilities.
All fuel sources have a finite four-times-2014-total-energy envelope; it is a deliberately nonbinding diagnostic bound, not domestic/import capacity. No inferred hourly import rate.

Single named IEA2010 samples supply 2008USD costs; fleet coal/gas efficiencies 0.40/0.50 are assumptions below modern sample values 0.46/0.58. Nuclear resource is output-equivalent rather than reactor heat. All reported O&M is treated as variable for this variant, not claimed identified.

All currency is million constant2008USD. Electricity bus/retail70/80USD per MWh, oil22USD per MWh and service200USD per MWh are research prices, not nominal tariffs. Large finite opening cash makes finance nonbinding; zero carbon/support is a control rule, not actual historical Chinese policy.

No verified initial queue, retirement schedule or ages. Empty queue and zero retirements are explicitly assumed for a diagnostic decade only. online_year2014 means bookkeeping entry, not actual commissioning. Not suitable for2060.

Annual build limits equal 2014 observed additions, split thermal by the reconstructed named shares; total construction/connection150GW per year, technology ceiling20times opening, hydro lead5years are assumptions. Wind/solar capex decline3%/10% per year; other costs fixed.

Fixed NEA6.34% delivery loss; free aggregate grid operations and fixed one-for-one residual devices. No claimed endogenous fuel substitution, device replacement, regional network, H2, CCUS or storage.

Three bounded parameters,27candidates per rule; adaptive expectations0.5, instant expectations1, and no investment, all frozen before first fit. Zero intensity trend isolates elasticity. Already-seen holdout is evaluated only after training selection; failure cannot relax thresholds.
